frown.targetSense: 顔をしかめる、眉をひそめる
frown.senseSelectionReason: The only verb sense matches the visible movement of the eyebrows and unhappy face.
choices: 顔をしかめる、眉をひそめる
frown.inferenceExplanation: 「broken window」「eyebrows moved down」「face looked unhappy」が手がかりです。壊れた窓を見て眉が下がり、不満そうな表情になったので、frownは「顔をしかめる、眉をひそめる」だと推測できます。

slip.senseSelectionReason: The wet floor, near fall, and grabbed rail uniquely support the physical slipping sense.
slip.inferenceExplanation: 「wet floor」「almost fell」「grabbed the rail」が手がかりです。ぬれた床で足元を失い、転びそうになって手すりをつかんだので、slipは「滑る」だと推測できます。

guess.senseSelectionReason: The speaker lacks certainty and selects the most likely answer, matching the single source sense.
guess.inferenceExplanation: 「do not know the answer」「four choices」「seemed most likely」が手がかりです。答えを知らないまま最もありそうな選択肢を選んでいるので、guessは「推測する、言い当てる」だと推測できます。

crawl.senseSelectionReason: The baby moves on hands and knees before being able to walk, selecting the crawling sense.
finalFullEnglish: The baby cannot walk yet, so she began to crawl across the floor.
She moved on her hands and knees toward a bright toy.
When she reached it, she laughed.
crawl.inferenceExplanation: 「cannot walk yet」「on her hands and knees」「toward a bright toy」が手がかりです。まだ歩けない赤ちゃんが手とひざを使って床を進んでいるので、crawlは「はう」だと推測できます。

as a general rule.targetSense: 概して、一般的に言えば
as a general rule.senseSelectionReason: A usual closing time is contrasted with a Friday exception, directly supporting a rule that generally applies.
choices: 概して、一般的に言えば
as a general rule.inferenceExplanation: 「our library closes at six」「However」「until eight on Fridays」が手がかりです。普段の閉館時刻に金曜日だけ例外があるため、as a general ruleは「概して、一般的に言えば」だと推測できます。

for a fresh start.targetSense: 新たなスタートとして、心機一転
for a fresh start.senseSelectionReason: Moving away from old problems and building a hopeful life supports the single phrase sense.
choices: 新たなスタートとして、心機一転
finalFullEnglish: For a fresh start, Leo moved to another town and joined a sports club.
He left his old problems behind.
Soon, he made friends and felt hopeful about his life there.
for a fresh start.inferenceExplanation: 「moved to another town」「left his old problems behind」「made friends and felt hopeful」が手がかりです。以前の問題から離れて別の町で前向きな生活を築いているので、for a fresh startは「新たなスタートとして、心機一転」だと推測できます。

on a specific occasion.senseSelectionReason: The contrast between most days and one dated special show supports the single phrase sense.
on a specific occasion.inferenceExplanation: 「most days」「special show」「The date is written on the website」が手がかりです。普段とは異なる特別な催しの日だけ料金が必要なので、on a specific occasionは「特定の機会に」だと推測できます。

in case of emergency.targetSense: 緊急時には、非常の場合に備えて
in case of emergency.senseSelectionReason: A special hotel phone and instructions for urgent trouble support the single phrase sense.
choices: 緊急時には、非常の場合に備えて
in case of emergency.inferenceExplanation: 「red phone」「call the front desk」「sign explains this」が手がかりです。ホテルに特別な電話と利用案内があり、重大な事態で連絡する場面なので、in case of emergencyは「緊急時には、非常の場合に備えて」だと推測できます。

on one's own.senseSelectionReason: The person completes a repair with no one helping, which supports independent action.
finalFullEnglish: Mika wanted to fix her bicycle on her own.
Her father was away, and no one helped her while she worked.
She felt proud when the wheels turned again.
on one's own.inferenceExplanation: 「wanted to fix her bicycle」「no one helped her」「felt proud」が手がかりです。助ける人がいない中で修理を終え、その結果を誇らしく感じているので、on one's ownは「自分一人で、独力で」だと推測できます。

on the air.senseSelectionReason: A radio host speaks into a microphone while listeners hear the program, supporting the broadcast sense.
on the air.inferenceExplanation: 「spoke into the microphone」「people in their cars could hear her」「could not stop to talk privately」が手がかりです。司会者の声がその時にリスナーへ届いているので、on the airは「放送中で」だと推測できます。

at a distance.senseSelectionReason: The sign is unreadable until the viewers walk closer, supporting observation from far away.
finalFullEnglish: The sign looked small at a distance.
When we walked closer, we could read every word.
At first, the letters had been too small to read.
at a distance.inferenceExplanation: 「looked small」「walked closer」「too small to read」が手がかりです。近づく前は文字が小さく読めなかったので、at a distanceは「離れて、遠くから」だと推測できます。

to one's surprise.senseSelectionReason: The clock works despite everyone's expectation that it was broken, creating a surprising result.
to one's surprise.inferenceExplanation: 「old clock still worked perfectly」「thought it was broken」「owner smiled」が手がかりです。壊れていると思われた時計が動き出す予想外の結果なので、to one's surpriseは「（人が）驚いたことに」だと推測できます。

go along with.senseSelectionReason: Mina changes from disliking the plan to packing and joining her friends, supporting acceptance of their plan.
go along with.inferenceExplanation: 「did not like the camping plan」「friends supported it」「packed her bag」が手がかりです。最初は嫌だった計画を受け入れて参加の準備をしたので、go along withは「（案・人に）賛成する、従う」だと推測できます。

take away from.senseSelectionReason: Noise makes the film difficult to follow and less enjoyable, selecting the reduce-value sense rather than physical removal.
take away from.inferenceExplanation: 「Loud music」「could not hear the actors」「became enjoyable again」が手がかりです。音楽が映画を楽しむ妨げになっているので、take away fromは「〜の価値（魅力）を損なう」だと推測できます。

bring out in.senseSelectionReason: Encouragement causes a previously hidden confidence to appear, supporting the elicit sense.
finalFullEnglish: The art teacher's kind words bring out in Ken a confidence he did not show before.
He began to share his paintings with the class.
Later, he volunteered to show his work at the school festival.

finalContextClues.text: confidence he did not show before

bring out in.inferenceExplanation: 「kind words」「confidence he did not show before」「volunteered to show his work」が手がかりです。先生の言葉によって以前は見せなかった自信が表れたので、bring out inは「引き出す」だと推測できます。

watch out for.senseSelectionReason: Loose stones may cause a fall, and the walker changes behavior to avoid the danger.
watch out for.inferenceExplanation: 「loose stones」「make you fall」「walk slowly」が手がかりです。転倒につながる石に注意しながら進む場面なので、watch out forは「〜に気をつける、用心する」だと推測できます。
